notes: QuietShield 2.9.34 Code360 Final: when protection is PAUSED/orange, tapping the main QuietShield protection control turns protection on/resumes it instead of opening another turn-off-for-10-minutes choice. The What's New Update log is restored as persistent bundled history sourced from assets/whats_new, so Code360 and prior bundled notes remain reopenable instead of rendering an empty page. A shared ProtectionTogglePolicy keeps action and accessibility labeling consistent across OFF, PAUSED, ON, pending, and locked states. Code359 Private Browser controls, dashboard return-state repair, Connection Intelligence, FileSafety, anti-rollback security, permanent signer identity, backup/restore, and no-new-MITM boundaries are retained.
